SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_board_mst')
INSERT INTO "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_mst ( board_seq, office_seq, category_code, title, content, view_count, post_status, del_yn, create_user, create_at, is_pinned, pinned_start_at, pinned_end_at ) VALUES ( #{boardSeq}, #{officeSeq}, #{categoryCode}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, COALESCE(#{postStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PUBLISHED'), 'N', #{createUser}, NOW(), #{isPinned, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pinnedStartAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pinnedEndAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_mst SET category_code = #{categoryCode}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, post_status = COALESCE(#{postStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PUBLISHED'), is_pinned = #{isPinned, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, pinned_start_at = #{pinnedStartAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, pinned_end_at = #{pinnedEndAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = NOW() WHERE board_seq = #{boardSeq} AND office_seq = #{officeSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_seq AS boardSeq, b.office_seq AS officeSeq, b.category_code AS categoryCode, c.board_name AS categoryCodeName, b.title, b.content, b.view_count AS viewCount, b.post_status AS postStatus, b.del_yn AS delYn, b.create_user AS createUser, u.user_name_ko AS createUserName, COALESCE( (SELECT d.dept_name FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_office_employee e JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_dept_mst d ON e.dept_seq = d.dept_seq AND d.del_yn = 'N' WHERE e.user_mst_seq = u.user_mst_seq AND e.office_seq = b.office_seq AND e.del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1 ), u.dept_name ) AS createUserDeptName, (SELECT CONCAT(fr.repository_url, '/', fm.file_nm) FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mapp fp JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mst fm ON fp.file_seq = fm.file_seq AND fm.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_repository fr ON fm.file_repository_seq = fr.file_repository_seq WHERE fp.tbl_seq = u.user_info_seq AND fp.file_category_code = 'profileImage' AND fp.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY fp.create_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS createUserProfileImageUrl, b.create_at AS createAt, b.update_user AS updateUser, b.update_at AS updateAt, b.is_pinned AS isPinned, b.pinned_start_at AS pinnedStartAt, b.pinned_end_at AS pinnedEndAt, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mapp p WHERE p.tbl_seq = b.board_seq AND p.del_yn = 'N' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS hasFile FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_mst b LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info u ON b.create_user = u.user_info_seq LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_mst c ON b.category_code = c.config_seq WHERE b.board_seq = #{boardSeq} AND b.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND b.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.board_seq AS "boardSeq", b.office_seq AS "officeSeq", b.category_code AS "categoryCode", c.board_name AS "categoryCodeName", b.title AS "title", b.content AS "content", b.view_count AS "viewCount", b.create_user AS "createUser", u.user_name_ko AS "createUserName", b.create_at AS "createAt", b.is_pinned AS "isPinned", b.pinned_start_at AS "pinnedStartAt", b.pinned_end_at AS "pinnedEndAt", COALESCE(b.post_status, 'PUBLISHED') AS "postStatus", CASE WHEN f.tbl_seq IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "hasFile", COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS "commentCount" FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_mst b LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info u ON b.create_user = u.user_info_seq INNER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_mst c ON b.category_code = c.config_seq AND c.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tbl_seq FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mapp WHERE del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY tbl_seq ) f ON f.tbl_seq = b.board_seq LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.board_seq, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_comment_mapp m INNER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_comment cm ON m.comment_seq = cm.comment_seq AND cm.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY m.board_seq ) cc ON cc.board_seq = b.board_seq LEFT JOIN ( SELECT config_seq, MAX(CASE WHEN (target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND ref_seq = #{request.userInfoSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (target_type = 'DEPT' AND ref_seq = #{request.userDeptSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_access FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_target WHERE target_role = 'READ_AUTH' AND del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY config_seq ) perm ON perm.config_seq = b.category_code WHERE b.office_seq = #{request.officeSeq} AND b.del_yn = 'N' AND (COALESCE(b.post_status, 'PUBLISHED') != 'DRAFT' OR b.create_user = #{request.userInfoSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (perm.config_seq IS NULL OR perm.has_access = 1) ) T
ORDER BY T."createAt" DESC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.offSet}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT b.board_seq AS "boardSeq", b.category_code AS "categoryCode", b.title AS "title", b.create_user AS "createUser", u.user_name_ko AS "createUserName", b.create_at AS "createAt", COALESCE(b.post_status, 'PUBLISHED') AS "postStatus" FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_mst b LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info u ON b.create_user = u.user_info_seq INNER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_mst c ON b.category_code = c.config_seq AND c.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT config_seq, MAX(CASE WHEN (target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND ref_seq = #{request.userInfoSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (target_type = 'DEPT' AND ref_seq = #{request.userDeptSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_access FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_target WHERE target_role = 'READ_AUTH' AND del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY config_seq ) perm ON perm.config_seq = b.category_code WHERE b.office_seq = #{request.officeSeq} AND b.del_yn = 'N' AND (COALESCE(b.post_status, 'PUBLISHED') != 'DRAFT' OR b.create_user = #{request.userInfoSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (perm.config_seq IS NULL OR perm.has_access = 1) ) T

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.config_seq AS "configSeq" ,A.parent_seq AS "parentSeq" ,A.board_type AS "boardType" ,A.board_name AS "boardName" ,A.description AS "description" ,A.share_scope AS "shareScope" ,A.admin_write_only_yn AS "adminWriteOnlyYn" ,A.notice_auth_type AS "noticeAuthType" ,A.new_post_alert_yn AS "newPostAlertYn" ,A.use_reaction_yn AS "useReactionYn" ,A.prefix_tags AS "prefixTags" ,A.view_type AS "viewType" ,A.status AS "status" ,A.disp_ord AS "dispOrd" ,A.del_yn AS "delYn" ,A.create_user AS "createUser" ,A.create_at AS "createAt" ,A.update_user AS "updateUser" ,A.update_at AS "updateAt" FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_mst A WHERE A.del_yn = 'N' AND A.office_seq = #{request.officeSeq} ) T
ORDER BY T."parentSeq" NULLS FIRST, T."dispOrd" ASC, T."createAt" ASC

SELECT A.config_seq ,A.parent_seq ,A.board_type ,A.board_name ,A.description ,A.share_scope ,A.admin_write_only_yn ,A.notice_auth_type ,A.new_post_alert_yn ,A.use_reaction_yn ,A.prefix_tags ,A.view_type ,A.status ,A.disp_ord ,A.del_yn ,A.create_user ,A.create_at ,A.update_user ,A.update_at FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_mst A WHERE A.config_seq = #{configSeq}

SELECT t.boardSeq, t.categoryCode, t.categoryCodeName, t.title, t.viewCount, t.postStatus, t.hasFile, t.commentCount, t.createUser, t.createUserName, t.createAt, t.isPinned, t.pinnedStartAt, t.pinnedEndAt FROM ( SELECT b.board_seq AS boardSeq, b.category_code AS categoryCode, c.board_name AS categoryCodeName, b.title, b.view_count AS viewCount, COALESCE(b.post_status, 'PUBLISHED') AS postStatus, b.create_user AS createUser, u.user_name_ko AS createUserName, b.create_at AS createAt, b.is_pinned AS isPinned, b.pinned_start_at AS pinnedStartAt, b.pinned_end_at AS pinnedEndAt, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mapp p WHERE p.tbl_seq = b.board_seq AND p.del_yn = 'N' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS hasFile, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_comment_mapp m INNER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_comment cm ON m.comment_seq = cm.comment_seq WHERE m.board_seq = b.board_seq AND cm.del_yn = 'N' ) AS commentCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY b.category_code ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.is_pinned = 'Y' AND (b.pinned_end_at IS NULL OR b.pinned_end_at >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, b.create_at DESC ) AS rn FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_mst b LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info u ON b.create_user = u.user_info_seq LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_mst c ON b.category_code = c.config_seq WHERE b.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND b.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(b.post_status, 'PUBLISHED') != 'DRAFT' ) t WHERE t.rn <= #{limit} ORDER BY t.categoryCode, CASE WHEN t.isPinned = 'Y' AND (t.pinnedEndAt IS NULL OR t.pinnedEndAt >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, t.createAt DESC

SELECT M.config_seq ,M.master_user_id ,I.user_name_ko as masterUserName ,M.create_user ,M.create_at FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_mapp M LEFT OUTER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info I ON M.master_user_id = I.user_info_seq WHERE M.config_seq = #{configSeq}

SELECT A.backup_seq ,A.office_seq ,A.config_seq ,A.board_name ,A.status ,A.file_path ,CONCAT('/api/board/backup/download/', A.backup_seq) as downloadUrl ,A.file_size ,A.file_name ,A.file_seq ,A.del_yn ,A.create_user ,A.create_at ,A.update_user ,A.update_at ,U.user_name_ko as requestUserName FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_backup_hist A LEFT OUTER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info U ON A.create_user = U.user_info_seq INNER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mst B ON A.file_seq = B.file_seq AND B.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_repository C ON B.file_repository_seq = C.file_repository_seq AND C.del_yn = 'N' WHERE A.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND A.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY A.create_at DESC

SELECT A.backup_seq ,A.office_seq ,A.config_seq ,A.board_name ,A.status ,A.file_path ,CONCAT('/api/board/backup/download/', A.backup_seq) as downloadUrl ,A.file_size ,A.file_name ,A.file_seq ,A.del_yn ,A.create_user ,A.create_at ,A.update_user ,A.update_at FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_backup_hist A INNER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mst B ON A.file_seq = B.file_seq AND B.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_repository C ON B.file_repository_seq = C.file_repository_seq AND C.del_yn = 'N' WHERE A.backup_seq = #{backupSeq}

SELECT b.board_seq AS boardSeq, b.office_seq AS officeSeq, b.category_code AS categoryCode, c.board_name AS categoryCodeName, b.title, b.content, b.view_count AS viewCount, b.create_user AS createUser, u.user_name_ko AS createUserName, b.create_at AS createAt, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mapp p WHERE p.tbl_seq = b.board_seq AND p.del_yn = 'N' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS hasFile FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_mst b LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info u ON b.create_user = u.user_info_seq LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_mst c ON b.category_code = c.config_seq WHERE b.office_seq = #{request.officeSeq} AND b.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY b.create_at DESC

SELECT mst.file_seq AS fileSeq, mst.file_original_nm AS fileName, CONCAT(repo.repository_url, '/', mst.file_nm) AS downloadUrl FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mapp mapp INNER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mst mst ON mapp.file_seq = mst.file_seq AND mst.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_repository repo ON mst.file_repository_seq = repo.file_repository_seq AND repo.del_yn = 'N' WHERE mapp.tbl_seq = #{boardSeq} AND mapp.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND mapp.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT e.dept_seq FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_office_employee e JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info u ON e.user_mst_seq = u.user_mst_seq WHERE u.user_info_seq = #{userInfoSeq} AND e.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND e.del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT target_seq AS targetSeq ,config_seq AS configSeq ,target_role AS targetRole ,target_type AS targetType ,ref_seq AS refSeq ,note ,create_user AS createUser ,create_at AS createAt ,update_user AS updateUser ,update_at AS updateAt ,del_yn AS delYn FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_board_config_target WHERE config_seq = #{configSeq} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY target_role, target_type, create_at

SELECT c.comment_seq AS commentSeq ,c.parent_comment_seq AS parentCommentSeq ,c.comment_type AS commentType ,c.comment_content AS commentContent ,c.comment_code AS commentCode ,c.del_yn AS delYn ,c.create_user AS createUser ,u.user_name_ko AS createUserName ,COALESCE( (SELECT d.dept_name FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_office_employee e JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_dept_mst d ON e.dept_seq = d.dept_seq AND d.del_yn = 'N' WHERE e.user_mst_seq = u.user_mst_seq AND e.del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1 ), u.dept_name ) AS createUserDeptName ,(SELECT CONCAT(fr.repository_url, '/', fm.file_nm) FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mapp fp JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mst fm ON fp.file_seq = fm.file_seq AND fm.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_repository fr ON fm.file_repository_seq = fr.file_repository_seq WHERE fp.tbl_seq = u.user_info_seq AND fp.file_category_code = 'profileImage' AND fp.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY fp.create_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS createUserProfileImageUrl ,c.create_at AS createAt ,c.update_user AS updateUser ,c.update_at AS updateAt FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_comment c LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info u ON c.create_user = u.user_info_seq WHERE c.comment_seq = #{commentSeq} AND c.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT c.comment_seq AS commentSeq ,c.parent_comment_seq AS parentCommentSeq ,c.comment_type AS commentType ,c.comment_content AS commentContent ,c.comment_code AS commentCode ,c.del_yn AS delYn ,c.create_user AS createUser ,u.user_name_ko AS createUserName ,COALESCE( (SELECT d.dept_name FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_office_employee e JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_dept_mst d ON e.dept_seq = d.dept_seq AND d.del_yn = 'N' WHERE e.user_mst_seq = u.user_mst_seq AND e.del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1 ), u.dept_name ) AS createUserDeptName ,(SELECT CONCAT(fr.repository_url, '/', fm.file_nm) FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mapp fp JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_mst fm ON fp.file_seq = fm.file_seq AND fm.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_file_repository fr ON fm.file_repository_seq = fr.file_repository_seq WHERE fp.tbl_seq = u.user_info_seq AND fp.file_category_code = 'profileImage' AND fp.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY fp.create_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS createUserProfileImageUrl ,c.create_at AS createAt ,c.update_user AS updateUser ,c.update_at AS updateAt FROM "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_comment c INNER JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_comment_mapp m ON c.comment_seq = m.comment_seq LEFT JOIN "MP_IPMS_PA".utb_user_info u ON c.create_user = u.user_info_seq WHERE m.board_seq = #{boardSeq} ORDER BY c.create_at ASC
